name: modernizers
description: Explore organizational change using published Modernizers perspectives.

interface.longDescription: Explore challenges in organizational and technological change using published perspectives from Modernizers.io. Search in English, Dutch or Brazilian Portuguese, compare possible explanations, and follow links to the original sources. Access requires a confirmed, free Modernizers subscription.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand why teams keep escalating decisions.
What can make it difficult to change an existing system?
Find perspectives on learning from successful projects.

prompts: Why do teams keep escalating decisions?
Find Modernizers perspectives on keeping software maintainable.
Quais perspectivas ajudam a entender por que mudanças organizacionais são difíceis?

positive.description: Search for organizational decision-making in English.
positive.prompt: Why might teams keep escalating decisions? Use Modernizers perspectives.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain plausible causes using relevant returned excerpts; link the actual sources used and credit Freddy Vorstenbosch and Modernizers.io.

positive.description: Search the Dutch collection about software maintenance.
positive.prompt: Wat zegt Modernizers over het onderhouden van bestaande software?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer in Dutch from relevant returned passages and link and attribute the sources used.

positive.description: Search the Brazilian Portuguese collection about organizational change.
positive.prompt: Por que as mudanças organizacionais podem ser difíceis? Procure perspectivas no Modernizers.
positive.expected_behavior: Answer in Brazilian Portuguese using relevant results and cite and attribute the sources used.

positive.description: Compare different explanations for a change problem.
positive.prompt: A system replacement is delayed. What different causes should I investigate? Use Modernizers.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish possible explanations from established facts, use relevant results and cite and attribute the sources used.

positive.description: Find sources about learning from a successful project.
positive.prompt: Find Modernizers articles on learning from a project that succeeded.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify relevant returned sources with their actual titles and URLs; credit Freddy Vorstenbosch and Modernizers.io.

negative.description: Explain that the integration cannot edit or publish articles. Do not call search_modernizers to perform this action or claim it was completed.
negative.prompt: Edit the latest Modernizers article and publish my changes.

negative.description: Explain that the integration cannot access a subscriber list. Do not call search_modernizers to retrieve private subscriber details.
negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses of all Modernizers subscribers.

negative.description: Explain that the integration cannot send email. Do not call search_modernizers to send a newsletter or claim that one was sent.
negative.prompt: Send the latest Modernizers article to every subscriber.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free to use for confirmed Modernizers subscribers and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Modernizers source search and perspective guidance.

nl-NL.subtitle: Onderzoek verandering
nl-NL.description: Onderzoek vraagstukken rond organisatie en technologie met inzichten van Modernizers.io. Zoek in het Nederlands, Engels of Braziliaans-Portugees, vergelijk mogelijke verklaringen en lees de oorspronkelijke bronnen. Toegang is gratis voor bevestigde Modernizers-abonnees.

pt-BR.subtitle: Explore mudanças com clareza
pt-BR.description: Explore desafios de mudanças organizacionais e tecnológicas com os conteúdos publicados no Modernizers.io. Pesquise em português brasileiro, inglês ou holandês, compare possíveis explicações e acesse as fontes originais. O acesso é gratuito para assinantes confirmados do Modernizers.
